text:
nina: Auditor Claire just asked for evidence that RBAC removals since 2025-02-01 were approved, executed, and archived. They want a reproducible export + cryptographic proof.

sam: Do they want the approval emails or the audit trail of the change events?

auditor_claire: Prefer the audit trail + pointer to approval (Jira change request id). We need a signed bundle: event export, approval references, and a signature we can verify with the KMS public key.

leo: Proposed flow: 1) export role_mod events from kafka topic auth-audit for date range; 2) join with change_request table for approval refs; 3) scrub PII; 4) compute SHA256 of scrubbed export; 5) sign hash using asymmetric KMS key; 6) produce manifest mapping events -> kafka partitions/offsets + jira ids.

nina: Example extraction (pseudo):
```
kcat -C -b kafka.prod:9092 -t auth-audit -o -1 -c 100000 | jq -c '.[] | select(.event=="role_mod")' > role_mod.raw.json
```

leo: Join snippet (pseudo):
```
python -c "import json;E=json.load(open('role_mod.raw.json'));# join with DB lookup to map change_request_id -> jira-1234" > role_mod.joined.json
```

sam: Redaction we use: strip user.email, session_token, request.headers.Authorization, request.client_ip. Also remove full email addresses in free-text.

nina: Scrub commands:
```
jq 'del(.user.email, .session_token, .request.headers.Authorization, .request.client_ip)' role_mod.joined.json > role_mod.scrubbed.json
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL_REDACTED]/g' role_mod.scrubbed.json > role_mod.scrubbed.redacted.json
```

leo: Then hash+sign: 
```
sha256sum role_mod.scrubbed.redacted.json | awk '{print $1}' > role_mod.sha256
aws kms sign --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 --message-type RAW --message fileb://role_mod.sha256 --output json > role_mod.signature.json
```

ops-bot: Note: KMS key alias is alias/redwood-audit-signing; rotation enabled every 365 days.

auditor_claire: Include the `aws kms get-public-key` response and a PEM so we can verify offline. Also include key policy excerpt and rotation timestamps.

sam: We'll include `get-public-key` output and convert to PEM. Also will provide a short script for verification using openssl.

leo: Verification example:
```
aws kms get-public-key --key-id alias/redwood-audit --output json > get-public-key.json
# extract and create pubkey.pem then:
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature <(jq -r '.Signature' role_mod.signature.json | base64 -d) role_mod.scrubbed.redacted.json
```

nina: Manifest fields: time_range, kafka_partitions_offsets (list), scrub_commands, signing_key_alias, signature_file, jira_change_refs (list), sample_vuln_tickets (list). We'll also include retention policy excerpt: audit logs 24 months, access logs 90 days. Map these to SOC2 CC6.2 and ISO 27001 A.12.4.

sam: Auditor also requested 4 example vuln triage tickets (sanitized): include timestamps, owner, severity, CVE, status, remediation date and an exported PDF timeline. We'll provide presigned S3 links valid 7 days.

s3-bot: Uploaded provisional bundle to s3://redwood-evidence/1759998888/role_mod_bundle_v1.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7d).

auditor_claire: Good. One question: for chain-of-custody, can you show the offsets and a minimal replay snippet that reproduces the export? We prefer reproducibility.

leo: We'll add `replay_commands.sh` showing kcat args with partition/offset ranges used. We'll keep minimal replay samples (3 events) and provide offsets in manifest.

sam: Also adding a checksum file list and a short attest.txt signed by the security lead with date/time and purpose. Do we need a secondary offline signature?

auditor_claire: KMS asymmetric signature + manifest is sufficient. An additional PGP/GPG attestation is optional. If you can provide it, mention it in manifest.

nina: Okay team — I'll assemble final bag: role_mod.scrubbed.redacted.json, manifest.json, role_mod.sha256, role_mod.signature.json, get-public-key.json, pubkey.pem, replay_commands.sh, vuln_samples.pdf, attest.txt. Upload and post presigned links here. Assign @leo to verify the scripts.

leo: On it. Will run a dry-run locally and paste verification output here when done.

s3-bot: Bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/1759998888/role_mod_bundle_final.tar.gz (size 6.1MB). Presigned links and manifest posted to audit-ticket-4321.

nina: Ping @auditor_claire once you see the links. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
